description: G12 — binary (unarmored) PGP v4 RSA-3072 public key. Same primary key as v4-rsa3072-pub.asc (fingerprint 3800518c…) but stored without ASCII armor. Exercises the binary-PGP path through Phase 2's content-sniffing detector and Phase 6's BC PGPUtil.getDecoderStream which transparently handles both armored and binary inputs.
source: gpg --export --no-armor of the same key in v4-rsa3072-pub.asc
